Reason for submitting the bill

The purpose of the Government in submitting this bill is to make the amendments required to Law No. 25/2019 (Income Tax Act) in order to revise the standards and principles for deducting interest payable by a taxpayer when calculating taxable income.

Member submitting the bill on behalf of the Government:
[signature]
Hassan Waheed
Vilufushi Constituency
18-10-2026

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

[emblem]

Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 25/2019 (Income Tax Act)

The following amendments are made to Law No. 25/2019 (Income Tax Act).

1. Repealing (c) of Article 71 of the said Act.

2. Repealing (d) of Article 71 of the said Act.

3. Repealing (e) of Article 71 of the said Act.

4. Amending number (2) of (o) of Article 71 of the said Act as follows.

71. (o) (2) "Interest capacity" means 25% (twenty-five percent) of the person's tax-EBITDA in that accounting period.

5. Repealing number (3) of (o) of Article 71 of the said Act.

6. Taxable income shall be calculated in accordance with the amendments made by this Act to Article 71 of the said Act for the tax year 2027 and subsequent tax years.

7. This Act shall come into force from 01 January 2027.
